scope: Read-only source and artifact inspection; arithmetic over existing logs; no candidate execution, new probes, model calls or hidden-only regrading.

definitions.recorded_initial_success: Full original benchmark verifier on first candidate; if only one decision, copied from final success; otherwise separately verified after episode, only scalar success retained.
definitions.recorded_final_success: Full original benchmark verifier on submitted final code, process success and nonce sentinel under sandbox limits.
definitions.visible_pass: Generated reference-certified frozen checks all pass; zero checks reduces to successful loading of candidate/harness.
definitions.confusion_label_warning: These are disagreements against recorded full-test success, not sensitivity/specificity against gold semantic correctness.
definitions.task_weighting: Compute four joint cell frequencies within each task, then average equally across tasks in that group. Conditional rates are ratios of task-weighted joint probabilities.
definitions.initial_grouping: Each model has four initial candidates per task, so episode- and task-weighted confusion agree. Terminal grouping by initial model retains that balance, but includes later randomized receiver switches.
definitions.last_receiver_grouping: Supplementary purely descriptive post-treatment grouping; task counts differ and it is not a causal model comparison.

judgments: Full-test endpoint is a valid narrow benchmark operational endpoint, not gold semantic correctness.
Sibling randomized action is receiver identity with fixed repair prompt; no randomized prompt wording contrasts can be recovered from it.
Later assertion splitting does not relabel existing outcomes; any newly exposed grader-derived inputs require a new endpoint or declared information intervention.
Zero-check pass must not be presented as substantive verification.
Absence of heuristic hack flags does not imply zero endpoint bias or absence of undetected exploits.
No new candidate execution or probes were run for this audit.
Passing correct reference solutions establishes compatibility at those executions, not discriminative verifier reliability.
Zero heuristic hack flags does not bound semantic-outcome bias at zero.
Outcome-selected informative-task count is not an effective sample size for general power calculations.
The original +4.6 percentage-point stopping headroom is an extrapolation scenario, not an identified counterfactual bound.

static_overlap_audit.method: Inspected sibling AST-based argument-key filter reproduced on canonical tasks and frozen certified checks. Parses source only; no program execution.
static_overlap_audit.limitation: Zero under syntactic call-argument matching does not establish semantic input disjointness, absence of prompt examples, absence of pretraining knowledge, or absence of grader leakage from later new probes.
static_overlap_audit.regrading_implication: Later split changes the graded assertion set and cannot be reconstructed from stored all-tests success flags. Full-test success logically entails subset assertion success only under unchanged deterministic harness semantics; a full-test failure does not identify which subset fails.

zero_check_disagreement_allocation.interpretation: Descriptive allocation, not the causal fraction of failures preventable by adding a checker.
